name: RealHyFC dynamic raw-DeltaV rolling horizon study; exploratory selected Seed202
features: Original14 Raw F2 slots, only fixed Top10 [0,3,13,11,4,9,6,7,10,8] active
preprocessing: Each horizon fits scaler to its legal TRAIN histories, in float64 from float32 raw histories, before within-history voltage EWMA(.3). Target scale is raw voltage TRAIN std, same as original. Both models at same H share identical prepared tensors and labels.
target: Raw V(t+h)-V(t), float32 labels as historical protocol. Predictions restored with original raw unsmoothed origin voltage. Physical scaling multiplication float32 as original; all metrics float64.
window_rule: Targets wholly in partition; histories may use earlier observed partition rows. No invalid bins, segment breaks, actual operating-clock gaps or calendar gaps>1.01s. All input14 channels finite. H-specific windows recomputed; full and H24 common-origin metrics both retained.
rolling: True last48 observed samples at each legal origin, direct H outputs, then advance origin and update with newly observed history. No prediction feedback; no actual future condition inputs.

hyperparameters.early_stopping: minimum full Validation standardized RMSE, min_delta 1e-12; mean training batch MSE in epoch log as original

LSTM: Independent single-layer LSTM14->64, last hidden -> linearH; internal dropout0 (single layer), no attention/CNN/additional regularizer
F2: Native TFT/LSTM/CNN/regime gate/convex fusion unchanged, only decoder length/relative-step coordinate/shape adapted to H;332436 trainable parameters

C1.head: 65->16 ELU->1 shared over forecast leads; final linear weight and bias zero initialized, preserves native initial output; no dropout or changed backbone
C1.alpha: 0.25*sigmoid(a); a initialized logit(.1), alpha initial .025, strictly between0 and.25
C1.information: Only native fused ENCODER historical states and known relative h/H. No decoder/real future covariates/labels passed to residual head.
C1.RNG: Construct head inside fork_rng(devices=[]) so CPU RNG state after native initialization is preserved. C0/C1 native backbone initialized identically. CUDA nondeterminism remains.
C1.preliminary_improvement_rule: Validation RMSE at least5% below fresh C0, MAE and P99 no worse; all per-lead errors and tails also disclosed. Single paired seed cannot establish stable gain. No candidate/hyperparameter replacement regardless of result.

evaluation_order: P1 historical read-only audit; P2 four fresh Train/Validation runs; P3 two fresh C0/C1 runs; freeze all6 best checkpoints before ONE unified descriptive HOLDOUT inference. Historical HOLDOUT already observed and seed selected from it; no blind-test/general seed claims.
metrics: float64 RMSE/MAE/R2 on raw DeltaV, same historical formula; P95/P99/max, largest ceil(1% queries) absolute-errors SSE share; target-time-equal RMSE averages per-target MSE, no ensemble. Fixed step1/6/12/24 and all lead curves where supported.
diagnostics: Train-only P75 zero-current fraction and load-transition thresholds; voltage-jump threshold P95 absolute adjacent TRAIN DeltaV in valid continuous pairs. Future measured target conditions only posthoc grouping, never inputs. Report query and unique-target counts, no independent-query inference.
protection: New directories only. No old checkpoint overwrite, no duplicate successful training, no training on holdout. Save errors and partial artifacts. No SOH/RUL/long-trend targets, no extra search or seed switch.
cuda: Original ordinary CUDA settings, strict algorithmsFalse because native interpolation backward is unsupported; cudnn deterministicTrue benchmarkFalse matmulTF32False cudnnTF32True. No bitwise reproducibility promise.
